messages:
alex_sales: Heads up — Acme POC just started returning 5xxs during the scripted ramp. Demo on the line. Can ops triage?

rui_se: Which route and model? sample request ids?

alex_sales: Route `acme-poc-edge`, model `redwood-hallmark-xl`. IDs: x1-77, x1-78. Pattern: stepped 10 -> 100 RPS in ~90s.

tara_support: Edge excerpts: 
```
[2026-06-10T16:14:11Z] request_id=x1-77 response=502 reason="upstream_overloaded"
[2026-06-10T16:14:12Z] request_id=x1-78 response=503 reason="burstpool_queue_full"
[2026-06-10T16:14:40Z] request_id=x1-79 upstream_error: autoscaler_attach_failed: quota_exhausted
```

ben_oncall: Autoscaler tried two scaleouts at 16:14:12 and 16:14:33. Cloud returned quota_exhausted for the preferred pool; fallback to shared-burstpool occurred and it hit max queue depth returning 503s.

rui_se: Short-term: patch route to `soft_limit_rps=45`, `fallback_model=redwood-hallmark-xl-quant`, `max_concurrency=1`, `elastic_burst=true`. Medium: move to reserved/dedicated for POC.

alex_sales: Acme wants minimal quality loss on demo. ETA for reserved?

ben_oncall: We can provision a dedicated-small in-region in ~3-6 hours via expedited ticket CH-11001 (owner: @rui_se). Non-expedited is 24-48h.

tara_support: I can apply the quick patch and collect full logs for Acme. Also propose a one-time credit to cover instability during the POC.

deploy-bot: Applying patch to route `acme-poc-edge`: {soft_limit_rps=45, fallback_model=redwood-hallmark-xl-quant, max_concurrency=1, elastic_burst=true} (patch id patch-9001).

deploy-bot: Patch applied. Post-patch metrics: 5xx rate dropped from ~20% -> ~3% within 40s; some requests served by quant fallback.

rui_se: I'll own CH-11001 and coordinate procurement. Recommend offering a credit and a short-term dedicated node for the demo.

alex_sales: I'll present that on the call. Also they asked about Private/VPC to avoid shared burstpool — what's timeline?

ben_oncall: Private deployment requires legal + infra signoff; ballpark 2-3 weeks. If they need isolation we can start intake but not for immediate demo.

tara_support: Logged credit and uploaded logs + incident notes to the Deal.

alex_sales: Owners recap: mitigation applied (tara_support), capacity ticket CH-11001 (rui_se), compliance/audit thread (ben_oncall), sales credit + proposal (alex_sales). Will update after call. :thumbsup:
